Gihivinaya

Pt.. (1) with Burmese paraphrase. Rangoon, 1894. (2) with Sinhalese interpretation 6th edn. Colombo, 1916. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 697; 1906-28. 1051.

Gihivinayakyan_Sā
